title: Rochdale magicians help organise North West Magic Dealers Day
excerpt: Two Rochdale-based officers of the Order of the Magi are helping organise a day of magic stalls and shared skills in Manchester on 15 November.
body:
Two Rochdale-based members of the Order of the Magi are helping organise a gathering for magicians, collectors and beginners in Manchester next month.

The North West Magic Dealers Day and Car Boot Sale takes place on Sunday 15 November, from 10am to 5pm, at the Irish World Heritage Centre in Cheetham Hill. It offers local people interested in magic a chance to browse specialist equipment and meet fellow performers.

Jonathan Royle, the society’s entertainments and public relations officer, and Stuart Cassels, its secretary and webmaster, are both based in Rochdale, according to the society’s press release. Their roles are also listed on the Order of the Magi’s website.

The organisers say more than 20 stalls will offer tricks, books, DVDs, stage props and second-hand equipment. They also plan informal sessions where performers can exchange ideas and learn from one another, alongside information about joining the society.

Admission is £4 per person. A £10 family ticket covers up to two adults and two children under 16. The ticket listing says under-16s must be accompanied by an adult.

The venue is at 1 Irish Town Way, off Queens Road, Manchester, M8 0AE. The event is being held in Manchester, rather than Rochdale. Food and drink will be available, and the organisers advertise free parking.

Event details and booking information are available at https://www.orderofthemagi.co.uk/dealersday. Readers planning a visit should check the organiser’s listing for any changes before travelling.

Do you perform magic, collect tricks or want to learn? Tell us what opportunities you would like to see for budding magicians in Rochdale.
